The scatter plot above shows the relationship between hours of study per week and the overall percentage obtained by students in a math class. What was the overall percentage obtained by the student who studied, on average,  $7$ hours each week?
worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/39e7370f9cf517a7a139fecf71561041a9b1470150e0fa333d3fff679f77882d.png)

    

To determine the overall percentage obtained by the student who studied $7$ hours each week, we locate $7$ on the horizontal axis and move in the vertical direction until we find some points, as shown above.

The highlighted point has coordinates $(7,85).$ Therefore, the student who studied $7$ hours each week obtained an overall percentage of $85%.$
